name: Masika
description: An initiate of the Tah crop whom Djeru sends to a pillar in place of Tausret.

timeline.summary: Four initiates volunteer to stand on pillars to open the door while holding the ammit and monsters; Djeru swaps Masika for Tausret and the four are left behind.
timeline.quote: Masika. I need you to switch with Tausret.
